_doc: Narration tones shared by tools/tts/voice.py (voice, speed, pause) and the animation (energy). An episode picks one with "tone" and may override voice/speed. Keep ONE narrator voice across the channel: it becomes the channel's identity.

relatable.label: Default: 'Have you ever noticed...' - warm, conversational, a smile in the voice

deep.label: Reflective endings and life lessons - slower, more air between sentences

funny.label: Comedy beats - quicker delivery, snappy pauses
